description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing Provisioning Categories within an Apache Fineract project. It includes endpoints for retrieving all categories, creating a new category, updating an existing category, and deleting a category. The class utilizes JAX-RS annotations for REST mappings, integrates with Fineract's command and security services, and is annotated with Swagger tags for API documentation.

classes.name: ProvisioningCategoryApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing provisioning categories, including creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting categories.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all provisioning categories.

methods.name: createProvisioningCategory
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new provisioning category based on JSON request body.

methods.name: updateProvisioningCategory
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing provisioning category identified by categoryId.

methods.name: deleteProvisioningCategory
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a provisioning category identified by categoryId.
